steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Odysseus returns to Ithaca disguised as a beggar by Athena's guidance — he must assess the situation before revealing himself | Key Fact: Eumaeus the swineherd and Philoetius the cowherd remain loyal to Odysseus and help him against the suitors | Key Fact: Odysseus and Telemachus plot the suitors' downfall together — father and son are reunited in secret | Key Fact: Penelope sets the contest of the bow — only Odysseus can string his own great bow and shoot through twelve axes
